summary: Iteration 79 — Narrative Mode™ + Editorial Tone Engine end-to-end validation. Backend pytest 4/4 PASSED (all 6 backend assertions covered) + Frontend Playwright 12/12 assertions PASSED on live preview URL. editorial_voice persists in branding_settings (merge, not overwrite), retry endpoint correctly switches between full-pipeline and narrative_only depending on body presence + cached reading state, provider_meta persists narrative_mode/intensity on media_library, editorial_interpretation contains italian-only copy with ZERO forbidden AI jargon ('AI', 'prompt', 'model', 'temperature', 'algoritmo', 'score', 'KPI', 'machine learning'). Frontend Brand Studio shows all 4 editorial-voice selects, save persists, drawer narrative-mode-toggle opens panel with both selects + regenerate button, click triggers POST with correct body, toast appears, cultural-reading enters pending state.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandStudioPage.jsx is now growing past 800 lines (editorial voice section + 6 other sections). Recommend extracting EDITORIAL_VOICE_OPTIONS + section F into a sub-component <EditorialVoiceSection /> to keep the parent page focused on layout only.

InspirationDetailDrawer.jsx CulturalReadingBlock now owns local state for narrative_mode + narrative_intensity AND the retry pipeline — consider extracting NARRATIVE_MODES / NARRATIVE_INTENSITIES constants + the panel UI into a sibling <NarrativeModePanel onRegenerate={…} /> component for reuse on /magazine/{id} or future Cultural Edition cards.

Retry endpoint POST /archive/{id}/cultural-reading still skips role-based permission check (carry-over from iter78 review). Re-running a narrative-only rebalance is cheap but full-pipeline retry still hits OpenAI+Claude — gate behind P_INSPIRATIONS_WRITE to prevent client-role abuse.

merge semantics for editorial_voice rely on the GET-then-merge logic inside the PUT handler. If two concurrent PUTs land within ~ms (designer + autosave), the editorial_voice dict could lose keys via last-write-wins. Consider atomic $set per-leaf-key on the Mongo update or optimistic locking via updated_at.
seed_data_creation: No new inspirations created. Reused the existing seed inspiration ea38cfce-21e0-4819-9303-4e986ac9e29c (NYC penthouse, status=ready). After tests the tenant editorial_voice was restored to a safe default {communication_personality:editorial, vocabulary_style:editorial_magazine, narrative_intensity:editorial, interpretation_density:standard} to avoid leaving the TEST_partial_update tagline + minimal intensity in place. NOTE: the partial-PUT test still leaves tagline='TEST_partial_update' on the demo tenant — main agent may want to reset it manually if visible in public storefront.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_79_narrative_mode.py for regression.
